intro.title: In the gallery, and after it
intro.body:
The course has given you art and artist, music and film. What it has not given you is the vocabulary for talking about any of it — the words a review uses, or a museum label, or a friend telling you what a book was actually like.
The first six are what you can walk up to and look at. The last six are what you carry home: the poem, the story underneath the story, and the music a country keeps.

intro.title: You will use these words in
intro.note: A collection is what a museum owns; an exhibition is the part of it currently on the wall. Folk is the odd one out grammatically — it is an adjective here (folk music, a folk song), not a noun.
intro.note_cz: collection = sbírka (co muzeum vlastní), exhibition = výstava (co je právě k vidění). Folk je přídavné jméno.
